declared_unknowns.description: The RTL slice [N-2:0] implies N must be at least 2; the SystemC implementation enforces this constraint and is simulated with default N=8.
sc_lv preserves four-state XOR propagation; the self-check includes one directed X and one directed Z input vector, but not an exhaustive four-state input space.
